# Arrival

Take about **60 seconds** to arrive.

- Sit comfortably.
- Notice a few sounds around you.
- Notice one physical sensation.
- Take one slow breath.
- Bring your attention back to the room.

# Today's Plan

1. Short opening
2. Name game
3. Make your first name tag
4. Introduction presentation
5. Work time
6. End-of-class routine

# Name-and-Action Game

**We will move away from our desks for this.**

1. Say your **preferred name**.
2. Add one **unique action or gesture**.
3. The next person repeats the previous **2-3 names and actions**.
4. Add your own name and action.

**Goal:** move, learn names, and make names easier to remember.

## Keep It Manageable

You do **not** need to memorize the whole class.

- Repeat only a few people before you.
- Help each other if someone gets stuck.
- The goal is participation, not perfection.

# Name Tag Version 1

::: {.big-prompt}
Make a name tag that helps me learn your name.

Use the materials available and make something you think will work.
:::

**Materials:** paper/card stock and markers

## When You Finish

- Take a **clear photo** of your name tag.
- Check that your **name is readable** in the photo.
- Submit the photo through **Google Classroom**, as directed.

# Your Introduction

- Follow the **posted rubric**.
- Keep it concise.
- Help us learn something meaningful about you.
- Submit the presentation by **7:00 PM**.
- If it is not submitted by 7:00 PM, you will still present using what is available.

## Submission Reminder

**Due: 7:00 PM**

You will present whether or not the presentation has been submitted.

Make sure the version you want to use is available before the deadline.

## Work Time

Use the remaining class time to build your introduction presentation.

Focus on:

- following the posted rubric
- keeping it concise
- making it easy to present

# Presentations

Most presentations will happen **Day 2**.

If time allows, students who are ready may begin today.

**Presentation order may be selected randomly.**
